scope: Bounded primary-source review of the current claims, not exhaustive novelty certification.
queries: affine disturbance feedback robust constrained control
affine output feedback purified outputs convex synthesis
active model discrimination task constraints minimum horizon
dual adaptive MPC active versus passive learning
unknown input delay compatible models common controller

sources.title: Design of Affine Controllers via Convex Optimization
sources.access: Full text accessible; relevant sections II-V examined; proofs not independently reproduced.
sources.locator: PDF pp.3-6, sections II-V; worst-case problem (7), convex reformulation (16).
sources.finding: Causal affine output feedback and worst-case convex synthesis are established.
sources.difference: Does not establish the exact unknown-delay task-preview frontier of this project.

sources.title: Input design for guaranteed fault diagnosis using zonotopes
sources.access: Full text accessible; introduction and sections 2-4 examined.
sources.locator: Automatica 50:1580-1589; sections 2-4, reachable output sets and separating inputs.
sources.finding: Bounded-error separating inputs are optimized with control-impact considerations.
sources.difference: Not a proof of our exact numerical deadline/precision boundaries.

sources.title: Closed-loop input design for guaranteed fault diagnosis using set-valued observers
sources.access: Full text accessible; sections 3-4 and relevant proof/constraints examined.
sources.locator: PDF pp.3-5, minimum separation horizon, eqs.(15)-(20), Theorem 1, Algorithm 1.
sources.finding: Minimum separation horizons, general polytopic uncertainties and measurement-updated input design are established.
sources.difference: Minimum diagnosis time is not the same optimization as task-recovery preview time.

sources.title: Model Predictive Control Combined with Model Discrimination and Fault Detection
sources.access: Full text accessible; sections 3-4, feasibility example and conclusion examined.
sources.locator: PDF pp.3-4, eqs.(11)-(14), Fig.1 and soft discrimination treatment.
sources.finding: Combining tracking and discrimination, including feasibility loss, predates this project.
sources.difference: Its formulation is not identical to our rate-bounded delayed-actuator problem.

sources.title: Finite Horizon Control Design for Optimal Model Discrimination
sources.access: Full text accessible; model assumptions, constraint treatment and discussion examined.
sources.locator: PDF p.2 Gaussian assumptions; pp.5 and 8 expected-state task constraints and limitations.
sources.finding: Task-constrained discrimination is an old problem family.
sources.difference: Expected-state/Gaussian statements are not our all-realizations bounded-noise guarantees.

sources.title: MPC with active learning for stochastic systems with structural model uncertainty: Online model discrimination
sources.access: Reopened full text; sections 2-4 and baseline comparison passages examined.
sources.locator: PDF pp.2-4 active/passive value and model hypotheses; section 5.3 baseline definitions.
sources.finding: The value of active versus passive learning depends on task and uncertainty.
sources.difference: Stochastic Bayesian formulation differs from bounded-error certification.

sources.title: Robust Data-Driven Output Feedback for Systems With Unknown Input Delays
sources.access: Reopened preprint v1; assumption paragraph and Theorem 3 examined.
sources.finding: Compatible unknown delays can share a stabilizing controller.
sources.difference: Synthesis addresses disturbance-free post-collection plants, not our ongoing disturbed endpoint task.

sources.title: Safe, Real-Time Active Model Discrimination and Fault Diagnosis for Nonlinear Systems via Differentiable Reachability
sources.access: Reopened preprint v1; sections III-V and result scope examined.
sources.locator: Section III Problem 2 / eq.(3); section V, consistency relaxed to a separation objective.
sources.finding: Set-based discrimination with nonlinear dynamics and robust constraints is already an active research area.
sources.difference: Its separating objective relaxation is not a certificate of every task-preview boundary.

access_limits: Harirchi et al. IFAC 2017 author PDF timed out twice; not treated as full-text evidence.
Heirung et al. 2017 author PDF redirected to a JS-only repository; no new full-text claim.
Previous review DOI 10.1049/cth2.12170 and 10.1016/j.conengprac.2017.03.007 remain incompletely accessed.
No paper was found with the exact local numeric frontier; this does not establish an original general result.
